# `srs render`

```text
Render document outputs from Compositions

Usage: srs render [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  composition    Render a Composition
  export-bundle  Export a record as a shareable ZIP bundle (rendered view + attachments)
  okf-bundle     Export a container as a Google Open Knowledge Format folder bundle
  markdown       Render markdown read from stdin to safe HTML (pure; needs no repository)
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

      --container <CONTAINER_ID>
          Container scope: constrains list/create/delete to this container's membership; on `context record` it adds the record's arrangement subtree in this container

      --actor <ACTOR>
          Session actor for everything this invocation creates (RFC-046 `createdBy`): JSON `{"kind":"human|ai","id":"<non-empty>","name":"<optional>"}`. Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. An invalid value refuses every creating command (`actor-invalid`); a corpus below dataModelRevision 9 refuses an actor session (`revision-too-old`) until `repo apply-migration --id rfc046-actor-provenance`. A `.srsj` migrated in memory on open refuses every write first (`migration-required-before-write`) until its migrations are applied

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## `srs render composition`

```text
Render a Composition

Usage: srs render composition [OPTIONS] --view <VIEW>

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          Repository path (defaults to auto-detect from current directory)

      --view <VIEW>
          Composition UUID

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON output (default)
          - yaml: YAML output
          - text: Human-readable text output (planned, currently returns diagnostic)
          
          [default: json]

      --view-format <VIEW_FORMAT>
          Optional render format override (markdown, text, adoc, html, json)

      --store <STORE>
          Storage backend override. By default the backend is inferred from the repository location
          
          [possible values: file, json]

      --theme-variant <THEME_VARIANT>
          Optional named theme variant defined on the Composition

      --instance <INSTANCE>
          Optional instance UUID: scopes ContainerSubset sections to this single record, producing a per-record export document

      --pretty
          Pretty-print JSON output (no effect on text format)

      --container <CONTAINER_ID>
          Container scope: constrains list/create/delete to this container's membership; on `context record` it adds the record's arrangement subtree in this container

      --exclude <EXCLUDE>
          Instance UUID to drop from ContainerSubset sections (repeatable); in an arranged section its descendants move up one level (RFC-043 promoting removal)

      --actor <ACTOR>
          Session actor for everything this invocation creates (RFC-046 `createdBy`): JSON `{"kind":"human|ai","id":"<non-empty>","name":"<optional>"}`. Defaults to the `SRS_ACTOR` environment variable; with neither, creations are unattributed. Host configuration only — a request payload never carries it. An invalid value refuses every creating command (`actor-invalid`); a corpus below dataModelRevision 9 refuses an actor session (`revision-too-old`) until `repo apply-migration --id rfc046-actor-provenance`. A `.srsj` migrated in memory on open refuses every write first (`migration-required-before-write`) until its migrations are applied

      --output <OUTPUT>
          Optional output file path for rendered content

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
